findings.claim: On the text-query results page (isSearch true) with image search available, FolderBrowser wraps the page in UploadZone with acceptUpload={false}, so a drag classed 'upload' no longer uploads. This contradicts I8 ('uploads exactly as before this change on the text-query page') and the spec's confirmed item that every other drop still uploads.
findings.impact: A drop of non-image files, several files or a folder on the text-query page does nothing while image search is available. Uploads still work while it is unavailable, because inner is returned without a zone. The behaviour differs by availability state, and the overlay (isDragging) is also suppressed for upload-class drags.
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/FolderBrowser.tsx:88 (isSearch = non-blank searchQuery, i.e. the text-query page) and :903-915 (isSearch with onImageQuery renders UploadZone acceptUpload={false}); frontend/src/components/UploadZone.tsx:109 (`if (!acceptUpload) return;`) and :64-69 (overlay shown only for one_image or acceptUpload). docs/specs/image-query-search.md:793-795 and I8 say the upload still happens.
findings.repro: Read the code path: with onImageQuery set and a text query, drop a PDF. classifyDrag gives upload, dropped !== 'one_image', acceptUpload is false, and handleDrop returns before addFiles.

bucket_proposal.reason: Violates declared invariant I8 and I7 (upload behaviour must be unchanged on the text-query page) in normal single-user use.

findings.proposed_fix: Pass acceptUpload (default true) on the text-query page. Pass false only on the image query view, if that view uses this wrapper.

verification.note: UploadZone.tsx:62-63 computes hasFiles = types.includes('Files') || files.length > 0. The added `files.length > 0` is new relative to the types-only check described, and it applies to every UploadZone use, including folder pages. In browsers, files is normally empty at dragenter and types already contains 'Files' whenever files exist, so a practical difference is unlikely. The textual change is real and untested.

The spec text (step 0/2 and I8) says an upload-class drop on the text-query page uploads as before. The code does the opposite: FolderBrowser.tsx:903-915 passes acceptUpload={false} when isSearch (the text-query page, line 88), and UploadZone.tsx:109 returns without uploading. This is more than stale prose, because the code regresses declared behaviour; see V1. The spec could instead be revised if the human wants this, but the spec at lines 793-795 says every other drop still uploads.

specification_compliance: I8: violated on the text-query page for upload-class drops (FolderBrowser.tsx:911, UploadZone.tsx:109).
I7: upload behaviour while image search is available is not the same as before the change.
potential_unspecified_behavior: Upload behaviour on the text-query page depends on whether image search is available for the drive.
UploadZone's hasFiles check now also accepts files.length > 0.
regression_risks: Uploads by drag and drop onto the text-query page stop working once the availability request returns 200.
The overlay for upload-class drags is suppressed on that page.
test_coverage: I did not inspect the frontend tests. The readers report no test of the folder-page overlay or of an upload-class drop on the text-query page with onImageQuery set.
not_verified: Whether the image query view uses FolderBrowser or another wrapper
